spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Tomlinson Run Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Tomlinson Run State Park on the shore.
